rfc1243.title: AppleTalk Management Information Base
rfc1243.abstract: This memo defines objects for managing AppleTalk objects for use with the SNMP protocol. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1378.title: The PPP AppleTalk Control Protocol (ATCP)
rfc1378.abstract: This document defines the NCP for establishing and configuring the AppleTalk Protocol [3] over PPP. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1419.title: SNMP over AppleTalk
rfc1419.abstract: This memo describes the method by which the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) as specified in [1] can be used over AppleTalk protocols [2] instead of the Internet UDP/IP protocol stack. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc1504.title: Appletalk Update-Based Routing Protocol: Enhanced Appletalk Routing
rfc1504.abstract: This document provides detailed information about the AppleTalk Update- based Routing Protocol (AURP) and wide area routing.  AURP provides wide area routing enhancements to the AppleTalk routing protocols and is fully compatible with AppleTalk Phase 2.  This memo provides information for the Internet community.  It does not specify an Internet standard.

rfc1742.title: AppleTalk Management Information Base II
rfc1742.abstract: This memo defines a portion of the Management Information Base (MIB) for use with network management protocols in TCP/IP-based internets.  In particular, it defines objects for managing AppleTalk networks. [STANDARDS-TRACK]

rfc6760.title: Requirements for a Protocol to Replace the AppleTalk Name Binding Protocol (NBP)
rfc6760.abstract: One of the goals of the authors of Multicast DNS (mDNS) and DNS-Based Service Discovery (DNS-SD) was to retire AppleTalk and the AppleTalk Name Binding Protocol (NBP) and to replace them with an IP-based solution.  This document presents a brief overview of the capabilities of AppleTalk NBP and outlines the properties required of an IP-based replacement.
